retention_tricks: Dynamic Editing: Fast cuts, zooms, on-screen text, sound effects to keep visual and auditory stimulation high.
Open Loop: Introduce a question or mystery at the start and only fully resolve it towards the end.
Pattern Interrupts: Unexpected visual or auditory changes, a quick cutaway, or a sudden change in tone to re-engage.
On-Screen Text: Subtitles or key takeaways displayed on screen to reinforce points and cater to sound-off viewing.
Story Arc: A mini-story with a beginning, middle, and satisfying (or surprising) end, even for short-form.
Cliffhanger Transitions: Hint at the next piece of information or a future reveal before a short break or cut.
